Claim 13 (currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising: a computer-readable medium having computer-executable instructions stored thereon for causing a computer to implement the steps of said method.

Claim 23 (currently amended): A computer-based system for trading combinations of financial instruments, said system comprising: a processing unit configured to obtain combination orders to trade financial instruments; and a matching engine configured to obtain a matched collection of expanded eligible orders, wherein an obtained order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, and wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments.

Claim 24 (currently amended): The system of claim 23, further comprising a quality assessment module configured to evaluate and improve the quality of said matched collection.

Claim 25 (currently amended): The system of claim 23, further comprising additional trading functionality associated with the matching engine to enhance trading operations.
